summary_1line: Lakshmana storms Kishkindha in anger at Sugriva’s delay, but Tara diplomatically calms him and explains Sugriva’s lapse due to indulgence.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana stands in Sugriva’s jeweled palace corridor, angrily drawing his bow as frightened attendants and jeweled women pause amid music and garlands.
Tara, slightly swaying from wine with a loosened golden girdle, approaches the stern Lakshmana who lowers his head respectfully before her.
Sugriva sits on a golden throne embracing Ruma among jeweled women when the formidable Lakshmana enters the inner chamber.
